collection.description: A young villager asks a scientist, a spiritual guide, and a Magic practitioner where humanity began.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (young), a young villager, asks a scientist, a spiritual guide, and a Magic practitioner where humanity began.

choices.label: Ask Each Person What They Do Not Know
Let the Child Form Their Own Questions

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The scientist discusses ancestry while others share cultural meanings.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (young) notices that a story can matter without serving as scientific evidence.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: One speaker struggles to admit uncertainty and later returns with a more careful answer.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Old tools inspire questions about earlier generations.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A shell fragment proves nothing about humanity's origins but starts a new investigation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (young) fills a page with wonderfully difficult questions.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (young) decides the most urgent mystery is who invented naps.
